question: Why did the error rate go up on 21 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment caused the error rate to increase.
why_chain: search v7.6 deployment introduced changes to the service search in ap-south.
The deployment occurred 217 minutes before the error rate increase.
The error rate increased from 0.48% to 1.07% after the deployment.

contributing_factors.description: No clear evidence of a configuration change.
why_chain: The error rate increase coincides with the deployment, suggesting a change in the system.
There is no evidence of a configuration change that would explain the error rate increase.
The request volume and latency did not change significantly, indicating the issue is not related to system capacity or user load.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of a configuration change that would explain the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in user load.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume did not change significantly, indicating the issue is not related to user load.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of a dependency issue with an external service.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service search in region ap-south rose from 0.48% to 1.07% (+122%), with a change point at 2026-03-21T11:55:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service search in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.18).
At the same time, request volume for service search in region ap-south stayed about the same (511 per 5 min before, 627 per 5 min after, +23%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service search in region ap-south stayed about the same (140 ms before, 138 ms after, -2%).
Deployed search v7.6 to ap-south (search, ap-south; 217 min before the change; record R009)
search: WARN slow query 1.2s on report endpoint (single occurrence) (search, us-east; 94 min before the change; record R010)

reasons: ✗ The closest change event is 217 min before the change, too far to be convincing.
✗ No logs or alerts from the affected segment confirm the problem.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
missing_data: Change records from the hour before the change
Error logs or traces from the affected segment after the change

actions.action: Roll back the search v7.6 deployment to ap-south.
Monitor the system for any further issues and adjust the deployment schedule if necessary.
Review and document the deployment process for future reference.
